BetweenSameGrounds.note: Two muted sections reading as one continuous ground with breathing room between them — which is the whole point: Divider draws nothing, it is empty ground at section rhythm.

Sizes.note: sm / default / lg as three visibly different gaps between the same two muted bands. Nothing is drawn; the growing space is the component.

OnDark.note: theme="dark" keeps the black continuous across the gap, so the bold block does not break into two.
